name: Swisscubing Cup V 2024
information: Swisscubing Cup V è parte della Swisscubing Cup 2024, che comprende 6 competizioni sull'arco dell'anno. Chiunque è benvenuto, indipendentemente dal fatto che sia intenzionato a partecipare alla Swisscubing Cup Finale. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup V ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2024. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup V is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2024, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.
